integrity: The proof is a direct consequence of the source's exact uniform-enumeration obstruction. For fixed standard k, oracle computation relative to the k-th jump of a parameter is arithmetically definable from that parameter, so a uniform Turing bound would produce precisely the forbidden arithmetical enumeration.
scientific_limitations: The escaping set may depend on the fixed finite jump level. The result does not produce a single set escaping all finite jumps, does not imply closure under jump, and applies only to omega-models.
title: Finite-jump unboundedness in reflected omega-models
